reasons.text: Another claim in the program shares this claimant's address, so the claim is flagged for review under the duplicate rule.
The label photo is legible and shows model AD10025GR, which is a recalled model.
The purchase at Amazon.com on 2023-07-11 falls inside the sale window and at a listed retailer; no receipt is required.
The destruction photo shows only the front of the device; the recall requires RECALLED marked on both the front and rear of the seatback, so the destruction requirement is not met.
The requested refund of $121.41 is over the $100.00 threshold, so a person must review it regardless.
